verification.notes: Contemporary reporting confirms Rabbi Michael Barclay framed antisemitism as a mutating form of hatred, but it also records him offering a substantive definition. The further characterization as Jewish supremacy and advocacy of murder is interpretive and not established by the cited interview record.
